For contractible globular theories, weak equivalence has the exact-boundary test; it has two-out-of-three, retract and filtered-colimit closure, and a weak equivalence lifting J_j lifts I_j.
Original-stage-order interpretation constructs R_k preserving all cells through k, for every k at most the fixed cutoff q.
Attachments I_j and J_j of index j>k preserve all cells through k, for k<q.
The finite spine T_m(S) has height at most m+1, retains all cells through m, and S is obtained from it by source attachments of index greater than m.
Every reflected free nonempty globular sum F_q(S) is contractible.
E(q,q) holds, including q=0.
Under E(q,j) for n<j<=q, upper I-cellular weak equivalences with cellular source split and remain weak equivalences after cellular pushouts.
Under the higher-index hypotheses, all free depth-n tree diagrams are contractible; generator homotopies are promoted using only J_(n+1).
Under the higher-index hypotheses, freely adjoining one independently oriented whisker at every actual n-cell of a globular sum gives a contractible model.
Cylinder realization has the exact one-sided skeletal pushout formula, with each shared face used once.

Under the higher-index hypotheses, the constructed P_j, A_j^epsilon for j>n, and P(S) for globular sums of height <=q are cellular and contractible; the one-sided maps above n are upper cellular weak equivalences.
All generators extend in the original free order on the partial path globular set, naturally in full models, preserving both endpoints even for composite faces of arity height j and output j-1.
Each endpoint lifts every boundary inclusion in A_q for every target model, not just cellular targets.
The joint endpoint lifts J_n, via a retraction of the upper-cellular inclusion of the four-vertex three-edge tree into P_(n+1).
For every q and 0<=n<q, higher-index expansions imply all of Proposition prop:partial-path, including its algebraic interpretations and both lifting properties.
The partial path construction implies E(q,n) for arbitrary cellular sources and arbitrary attaching cells.
For each fixed q, descending induction proves E(q,n) for every 0<=n<=q.
For every coherator in the manuscript convention, elementary expansions of all cellular models at every attaching cell are weak equivalences before reflection.
At a fixed q, C_PP_FIXED and C_PP_PATH require the generator arity bound only for outputs <=q; higher-output free generators may have arbitrary finite globular-sum arities.

claims.formal_statement:
import Mathlib

namespace PartialPathCore

inductive Shape where
  | node (arity : Nat) (children : Fin arity → Shape)

def point : Shape := .node 0 Fin.elim0

def Cell : Nat → Shape → Type
  | 0, .node p _ => Fin (p + 1)
  | k + 1, .node p children => (i : Fin p) × Cell k (children i)

def spine : Nat → Shape → Shape
  | 0, .node p _ => .node p (fun _ => point)
  | m + 1, .node p children => .node p (fun i => spine m (children i))

def retain : (k m : Nat) → (s : Shape) → k ≤ m → Cell k s → Cell k (spine m s)
  | 0, 0, .node _ _, _, x => x
  | 0, _ + 1, .node _ _, _, x => x
  | _ + 1, 0, _, h, _ => False.elim (by omega)
  | k + 1, m + 1, .node _ children, h, x =>
      ⟨x.1, retain k m (children x.1) (by omega) x.2⟩

def recover : (k m : Nat) → (s : Shape) → k ≤ m → Cell k (spine m s) → Cell k s
  | 0, 0, .node _ _, _, x => x
  | 0, _ + 1, .node _ _, _, x => x
  | _ + 1, 0, _, h, _ => False.elim (by omega)
  | k + 1, m + 1, .node _ children, h, x =>
      ⟨x.1, recover k m (children x.1) (by omega) x.2⟩

theorem recover_retain (k m : Nat) (s : Shape) (h : k ≤ m) (x : Cell k s) :
    recover k m s h (retain k m s h x) = x := by
  induction k generalizing m s with
  | zero =>
      cases m <;> cases s <;> rfl
  | succ k ih =>
      cases m with
      | zero => omega
      | succ m =>
          cases s with
          | node p children =>
              rcases x with ⟨i, x⟩
              simp only [retain, recover]
              rw [ih]

theorem retain_recover (k m : Nat) (s : Shape) (h : k ≤ m)
    (x : Cell k (spine m s)) :
    retain k m s h (recover k m s h x) = x := by
  induction k generalizing m s with
  | zero =>
      cases m <;> cases s <;> rfl
  | succ k ih =>
      cases m with
      | zero => omega
      | succ m =>
          cases s with
          | node p children =>
              rcases x with ⟨i, x⟩
              simp only [retain, recover]
              rw [ih]

def lowCellEquiv (k m : Nat) (s : Shape) (h : k ≤ m) :
    Cell k s ≃ Cell k (spine m s) where
  toFun := retain k m s h
  invFun := recover k m s h
  left_inv := recover_retain k m s h
  right_inv := retain_recover k m s h

theorem noHighCell (m k : Nat) (s : Shape) (h : m + 1 < k) :
    Cell k (spine m s) → False := by
  induction m generalizing k s with
  | zero =>
      cases k with
      | zero => omega
      | succ k =>
          cases k with
          | zero => omega
          | succ k =>
              cases s with
              | node p children =>
                  intro x
                  exact Fin.elim0 x.2.1
  | succ m ih =>
      cases k with
      | zero => omega
      | succ k =>
          cases s with
          | node p children =>
              intro x
              exact ih k (children x.1) (by omega) x.2

theorem uniqueFillerOperation {A B C : Type*} (boundary : C → B)
    (bijective : Function.Bijective boundary) (b : A → B) :
    ∃! operation : A → C, boundary ∘ operation = b := by
  classical
  let operation : A → C := fun a => Classical.choose (bijective.2 (b a))
  have fills : boundary ∘ operation = b := by
    funext a
    exact Classical.choose_spec (bijective.2 (b a))
  refine ⟨operation, fills, ?_⟩
  intro other other_fills
  funext a
  apply bijective.1
  have h₁ := congrFun other_fills a
  have h₂ := congrFun fills a
  exact h₁.trans h₂.symm

theorem naturality_comp {A B C A' B' C' : Type*}
    (f : A → B) (g : B → C) (f' : A' → B') (g' : B' → C')
    (a : A → A') (b : B → B') (c : C → C')
    (hf : b ∘ f = f' ∘ a) (hg : c ∘ g = g' ∘ b) :
    c ∘ (g ∘ f) = (g' ∘ f') ∘ a := by
  funext x
  exact (congrFun hg (f x)).trans (congrArg g' (congrFun hf x))

theorem naturality_of_jointly_injective_legs
    {I : Type*} {A T : Type*} {B : I → Type*}
    (legs : T → (i : I) → B i) (injective : Function.Injective legs)
    (f g : A → T) (h : ∀ a i, legs (f a) i = legs (g a) i) :
    f = g := by
  funext a
  apply injective
  funext i
  exact h a i

open CategoryTheory

universe u v

structure WeakRules {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C]
    (W : ∀ {X Y : C}, (X ⟶ Y) → Prop) : Prop where
  identity : ∀ X, W (𝟙 X)
  composition : ∀ {X Y Z} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z), W f → W g → W (f ≫ g)
  cancelFirst : ∀ {X Y Z} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z), W f → W (f ≫ g) → W g
  cancelSecond : ∀ {X Y Z} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z), W g → W (f ≫ g) → W f

theorem generatorPromotion {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C]
    (W : ∀ {X Y : C}, (X ⟶ Y) → Prop) (rules : WeakRules W)
    {A Q : C} (a₀ a₁ : A ⟶ Q) (r h : Q ⟶ A) (gf : A ⟶ A)
    (wa₀ : W a₀) (ra₀ : a₀ ≫ r = 𝟙 A) (ra₁ : a₁ ≫ r = 𝟙 A)
    (ha₀ : a₀ ≫ h = 𝟙 A) (ha₁ : a₁ ≫ h = gf) :
    W gf := by
  have wr : W r := rules.cancelFirst a₀ r wa₀ (by rw [ra₀]; exact rules.identity A)
  have wa₁ : W a₁ := rules.cancelSecond a₁ r wr (by rw [ra₁]; exact rules.identity A)
  have wh : W h := rules.cancelFirst a₀ h wa₀ (by rw [ha₀]; exact rules.identity A)
  rw [← ha₁]
  exact rules.composition a₁ h wa₁ wh

def DomainRetractClosed {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C]
    (W : ∀ {X Y : C}, (X ⟶ Y) → Prop) : Prop :=
  ∀ {X Y Z} (f : X ⟶ Z) (g : Y ⟶ Z) (i : X ⟶ Y) (r : Y ⟶ X),
    i ≫ r = 𝟙 X → i ≫ g = f → r ≫ f = g → W g → W f

theorem expansionRetract {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C]
    (W : ∀ {X Y : C}, (X ⟶ Y) → Prop) (rules : WeakRules W)
    (retractClosed : DomainRetractClosed W) {X Y : C}
    (i : X ⟶ Y) (r : Y ⟶ X) (u : X ⟶ X)
    (ri : i ≫ r = 𝟙 X) (wu : W u) (wv : W (r ≫ u ≫ i)) :
    W i := by
  have wui : W (u ≫ i) := by
    apply retractClosed (u ≫ i) (r ≫ u ≫ i) i r ri
    · rw [← Category.assoc, ri, Category.id_comp]
    · exact Category.assoc r u i
    · exact wv
  exact rules.cancelFirst u i wu wui

end PartialPathCore

import Mathlib

def target : (k : Nat) → (s : Shape) → Cell (k + 1) s → Cell k s
  | 0, .node _ _, x => ⟨x.1.val + 1, by omega⟩

  | zero => cases s <;> rfl
  | succ k ih =>

  have wr : W r := rules.cancelFirst a₀ r wa₀ (by rw [ra₀]; exact rules.identity A)
  have wa₁ : W a₁ := rules.cancelSecond a₁ r wr (by rw [ra₁]; exact rules.identity A)
  have wh : W h := rules.cancelFirst a₀ h wa₀ (by rw [ha₀]; exact rules.identity A)

def Cell : Nat → Shape → Type
  | 0, .node p _ => Fin (p + 1)
  | k + 1, .node p children => (i : Fin p) × Cell k (children i)

def spine : Nat → Shape → Shape
  | 0, .node p _ => .node p (fun _ => point)
  | m + 1, .node p children => .node p (fun i => spine m (children i))

def source : (k : Nat) → (s : Shape) → Cell (k + 1) s → Cell k s
  | 0, .node _ _, x => ⟨x.1.val, by omega⟩
  | k + 1, .node _ children, x => ⟨x.1, source k (children x.1) x.2⟩

def target : (k : Nat) → (s : Shape) → Cell (k + 1) s → Cell k s
  | 0, .node _ _, x => ⟨x.1.val + 1, by omega⟩
  | k + 1, .node _ children, x => ⟨x.1, target k (children x.1) x.2⟩

theorem source_globular (k : Nat) (s : Shape) (x : Cell (k + 2) s) :
    source k s (source (k + 1) s x) = source k s (target (k + 1) s x) := by
  induction k generalizing s with
  | zero => cases s; rfl
  | succ k ih =>
      cases s with
      | node p children =>
          rcases x with ⟨i, x⟩
          simp only [source, target]
          rw [ih]

theorem target_globular (k : Nat) (s : Shape) (x : Cell (k + 2) s) :
    target k s (source (k + 1) s x) = target k s (target (k + 1) s x) := by
  induction k generalizing s with
  | zero => cases s; rfl
  | succ k ih =>
      cases s with
      | node p children =>
          rcases x with ⟨i, x⟩
          simp only [source, target]
          rw [ih]

def retain : (k m : Nat) → (s : Shape) → k ≤ m → Cell k s → Cell k (spine m s)
  | 0, 0, .node _ _, _, x => x
  | 0, _ + 1, .node _ _, _, x => x
  | _ + 1, 0, _, h, _ => False.elim (by omega)
  | k + 1, m + 1, .node _ children, h, x =>
      ⟨x.1, retain k m (children x.1) (by omega) x.2⟩

def recover : (k m : Nat) → (s : Shape) → k ≤ m → Cell k (spine m s) → Cell k s
  | 0, 0, .node _ _, _, x => x
  | 0, _ + 1, .node _ _, _, x => x
  | _ + 1, 0, _, h, _ => False.elim (by omega)
  | k + 1, m + 1, .node _ children, h, x =>
      ⟨x.1, recover k m (children x.1) (by omega) x.2⟩

theorem recover_retain (k m : Nat) (s : Shape) (h : k ≤ m) (x : Cell k s) :
    recover k m s h (retain k m s h x) = x := by
  induction k generalizing m s with
  | zero =>
      cases m <;> cases s <;> rfl
  | succ k ih =>
      cases m with
      | zero => omega
      | succ m =>
          cases s with
          | node p children =>
              rcases x with ⟨i, x⟩
              simp only [retain, recover]
              rw [ih]

theorem retain_recover (k m : Nat) (s : Shape) (h : k ≤ m)
    (x : Cell k (spine m s)) :
    retain k m s h (recover k m s h x) = x := by
  induction k generalizing m s with
  | zero =>
      cases m <;> cases s <;> rfl
  | succ k ih =>
      cases m with
      | zero => omega
      | succ m =>
          cases s with
          | node p children =>
              rcases x with ⟨i, x⟩
              simp only [retain, recover]
              rw [ih]

def lowCellEquiv (k m : Nat) (s : Shape) (h : k ≤ m) :
    Cell k s ≃ Cell k (spine m s) where
  toFun := retain k m s h
  invFun := recover k m s h
  left_inv := recover_retain k m s h
  right_inv := retain_recover k m s h

theorem retain_source (k m : Nat) (s : Shape) (h : k + 1 ≤ m)
    (x : Cell (k + 1) s) :
    source k (spine m s) (retain (k + 1) m s h x) =
      retain k m s (by omega) (source k s x) := by
  induction k generalizing m s with
  | zero =>
      cases m with
      | zero => omega
      | succ m => cases s <;> rfl
  | succ k ih =>
      cases m with
      | zero => omega
      | succ m =>
          cases s with
          | node p children =>
              rcases x with ⟨i, x⟩
              simp only [spine, retain, source]
              rw [ih]

theorem retain_target (k m : Nat) (s : Shape) (h : k + 1 ≤ m)
    (x : Cell (k + 1) s) :
    target k (spine m s) (retain (k + 1) m s h x) =
      retain k m s (by omega) (target k s x) := by
  induction k generalizing m s with
  | zero =>
      cases m with
      | zero => omega
      | succ m => cases s <;> rfl
  | succ k ih =>
      cases m with
      | zero => omega
      | succ m =>
          cases s with
          | node p children =>
              rcases x with ⟨i, x⟩
              simp only [spine, retain, target]
              rw [ih]

theorem noHighCell (m k : Nat) (s : Shape) (h : m + 1 < k) :
    Cell k (spine m s) → False := by
  induction m generalizing k s with
  | zero =>
      cases k with
      | zero => omega
      | succ k =>
          cases k with
          | zero => omega
          | succ k =>
              cases s with
              | node p children =>
                  intro x
                  exact Fin.elim0 x.2.1
  | succ m ih =>
      cases k with
      | zero => omega
      | succ k =>
          cases s with
          | node p children =>
              intro x
              exact ih k (children x.1) (by omega) x.2

theorem uniqueFillerOperation {A B C : Type*} (boundary : C → B)
    (bijective : Function.Bijective boundary) (b : A → B) :
    ∃! operation : A → C, boundary ∘ operation = b := by
  classical
  let operation : A → C := fun a => Classical.choose (bijective.2 (b a))
  have fills : boundary ∘ operation = b := by
    funext a
    exact Classical.choose_spec (bijective.2 (b a))
  refine ⟨operation, fills, ?_⟩
  intro other other_fills
  funext a
  apply bijective.1
  have h₁ := congrFun other_fills a
  have h₂ := congrFun fills a
  exact h₁.trans h₂.symm

theorem naturality_comp {A B C A' B' C' : Type*}
    (f : A → B) (g : B → C) (f' : A' → B') (g' : B' → C')
    (a : A → A') (b : B → B') (c : C → C')
    (hf : b ∘ f = f' ∘ a) (hg : c ∘ g = g' ∘ b) :
    c ∘ (g ∘ f) = (g' ∘ f') ∘ a := by
  funext x
  exact (congrFun hg (f x)).trans (congrArg g' (congrFun hf x))

theorem naturality_of_jointly_injective_legs
    {I : Type*} {A T : Type*} {B : I → Type*}
    (legs : T → (i : I) → B i) (injective : Function.Injective legs)
    (f g : A → T) (h : ∀ a i, legs (f a) i = legs (g a) i) :
    f = g := by
  funext a
  apply injective
  funext i
  exact h a i

open CategoryTheory

universe u v

structure WeakRules {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C]
    (W : ∀ {X Y : C}, (X ⟶ Y) → Prop) : Prop where
  identity : ∀ X, W (𝟙 X)
  composition : ∀ {X Y Z} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z), W f → W g → W (f ≫ g)
  cancelFirst : ∀ {X Y Z} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z), W f → W (f ≫ g) → W g
  cancelSecond : ∀ {X Y Z} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z), W g → W (f ≫ g) → W f

theorem generatorPromotion {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C]
    (W : ∀ {X Y : C}, (X ⟶ Y) → Prop) (rules : WeakRules W)
    {A Q : C} (a₀ a₁ : A ⟶ Q) (r h : Q ⟶ A) (gf : A ⟶ A)
    (wa₀ : W a₀) (ra₀ : a₀ ≫ r = 𝟙 A) (ra₁ : a₁ ≫ r = 𝟙 A)
    (ha₀ : a₀ ≫ h = 𝟙 A) (ha₁ : a₁ ≫ h = gf) :
    W gf := by
  have wr : W r := rules.cancelFirst a₀ r wa₀ (by rw [ra₀]; exact rules.identity A)
  have wa₁ : W a₁ := rules.cancelSecond a₁ r wr (by rw [ra₁]; exact rules.identity A)
  have wh : W h := rules.cancelFirst a₀ h wa₀ (by rw [ha₀]; exact rules.identity A)
  rw [← ha₁]
  exact rules.composition a₁ h wa₁ wh

def DomainRetractClosed {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C]
    (W : ∀ {X Y : C}, (X ⟶ Y) → Prop) : Prop :=
  ∀ {X Y Z} (f : X ⟶ Z) (g : Y ⟶ Z) (i : X ⟶ Y) (r : Y ⟶ X),
    i ≫ r = 𝟙 X → i ≫ g = f → r ≫ f = g → W g → W f

theorem expansionRetract {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C]
    (W : ∀ {X Y : C}, (X ⟶ Y) → Prop) (rules : WeakRules W)
    (retractClosed : DomainRetractClosed W) {X Y : C}
    (i : X ⟶ Y) (r : Y ⟶ X) (u : X ⟶ X)
    (ri : i ≫ r = 𝟙 X) (wu : W u) (wv : W (r ≫ u ≫ i)) :
    W i := by
  have wui : W (u ≫ i) := by
    apply retractClosed (u ≫ i) (r ≫ u ≫ i) i r ri
    · rw [← Category.assoc, ri, Category.id_comp]
    · rfl
    · exact wv
  exact rules.cancelFirst u i wu wui

claims.natural_statement: At a fixed q, the fixed-cutoff theorem and partial-path construction hold for a contractible globular theory with a given free filler presentation that bounds arity only for generator outputs <=q; higher-output generators may have arbitrary finite globular-sum arities and only their prescribed-face equations.

routes.retired_because: The claim was restated to distinguish a free filler presentation with nonadmissible higher generators from Ara's stricter admissible-tower use of free. The mathematical argument is retained under the clarified context in a new route.

A mixed free-stage order cannot be replaced by output-dimension order. A composite face of output j-1 can have arity of height j; a smaller arity bound is not supplied. The valid route evaluates the whole preceding theory on S-tuples and uses Yoneda.
